source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Document each failed item specifically, noting the location, nature of the failure, and compliance status.
3. Take clear photographs of each failed item to accompany your documentation.
4. Record the presence of any fire hazards that contributed to the failure.
5. Specify the required corrective actions as recommended by the local fire safety codes or standards.
6. Note the date and time of the inspection and any further inspection schedule required.
7. Include the name, title, and contact information of the inspector and property owner or manager.
8. For automatic systems such as fire alarms, document the specific part that failed, the model, serial number, and maintenance history.
9. Provide details about communication with the building owner or manager regarding the failed checks.
10. Ensure that all documentation is saved in a secure, traceable location for easy retrieval and audit purposes.
11. Capture any witness statements if the failure was observed by occupants or staff.
